title: Navigating Text-to-Image Generative Bias across Indic Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the semantic faithfulness and correctness of generated images when prompted in 30 Indic languages compared to English, utilizing metrics like Cyclic Language-Grounded Correctness (CLGC), Image-Grounded Correctness (IGC), and Language-Grounded Correctness (LGC).

Assessing representational diversity and script-induced stereotyping (e.g., defaulting to specific religious attire, ethnic markers, or skin tones based purely on the language/script used) through self-consistency and distinctiveness metrics (SCAL, SCWL, DWL), alongside qualitative visual analysis.
